name: Transit Swap approval-drain campaign
summary: The authorized callBytes helper accepted an attacker-controlled target and calldata. The attacker used it to invoke the Transit transfer proxy's claimTokens function with arbitrary approved users as senders and the attacker as recipient.
notes: The directly deployed callBytes helper retained the same 6,123-byte runtime through the exploit.

Numen and SharkTeam report approximately $21 million stolen across the coherent Ethereum and BNB Chain approval-drain campaign. This is the gross incident-time loss; subsequent recoveries do not reduce it.
The $21 million loss is an approximate reported aggregate across the Ethereum and BNB Chain campaign; per-asset quantities and prices are not reconstructed here.
